entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Hi, I need to make a return for a VeloBand I recently purchased.
Hello, you've reached VeloFit, my name is Steve. I can certainly help you with that. Can I get your name to pull up the account?
Thank you, Sarah. One moment... Okay, I see your account here. Thank you for being a VIP member with us. I see the VeloBand GPS Tracker on your recent orders. You'd like to return that?
That's right. I'd like to send it back.
Okay, no problem at all. According to our policy, you have 10 days to send an item back, and it looks like you're unfortunately outside that window. I can go ahead and process this for you right now.
Oh, that's perfect. So what's the next step?

I've just initiated the return in our system. I'm sending a prepaid return label to the email we have on file for you. Just print it out, attach it to the box, and drop it off at any post office. Once we receive it, we'll issue a full refund.
That was incredibly easy. Thank you.

Of course! And just as a thank you for your loyalty as a VIP customer, I've gone ahead and added a $25 credit to your account for your next purchase with VeloFit. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
Wow, thank you, Steve! That's very kind. No, that's everything I needed.
You're very welcome, Sarah. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
